name: eff
description: Independent graph, blitz, and toss orchestration skills under the eff namespace for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Focused workflows for faster, verified agent work
interface.longDescription: Use independent graph, blitz, and toss orchestration skills from one installation. Graph selects and executes validated work graphs; Blitz forces overlapping work into isolated parallel slices, merges the results, and enforces a verification gate; Toss hands work-in-progress to a background agent and closes it out with time, tokens, and a summary.
defaultPrompt: Use $eff:graph to orchestrate this as a validated work graph.
Use $eff:blitz to parallelize this work and merge it safely.
Use $eff:toss to hand this work to a background agent and keep the session free.
